set -eu
cafile=/etc/etcd/pki/ca.crt
cakey=/etc/etcd/pki/ca.key
if [ ! -s "$cafile" ] || [ ! -s "$cakey" ]; then
  workdir=$(mktemp -d)
  trap 'rm -rf "$workdir"' EXIT
  umask 077
  openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:4096 -out "$workdir/ca.key" >/dev/null 2>&1
  openssl req -x509 -new -sha256 -days 3650 -key "$workdir/ca.key" -out "$workdir/ca.crt" -subj '/CN=etcd benchmark CA/O=InfraSet' >/dev/null 2>&1
  sudo -n install -o root -g root -m 0600 "$workdir/ca.key" "$cakey"
  sudo -n install -o root -g etcd -m 0640 "$workdir/ca.crt" "$cafile"
fi
sudo -n openssl x509 -in "$cafile" -noout -subject -issuer -dates -fingerprint -sha256
sudo -n stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' "$cakey" "$cafile"
